text: 悼念：王小明同志、张大同同志。
notes: 示亡号 (mourning frames) around 王小明 and 张大同. maxWidth 72 would naturally break inside 王小明 — MourningSpanKeptUnbroken moves the break to the span start instead. Frame rects hug the font-declared character face; the InterlinearMarkLineSpacingFloor (0.5em) keeps frames clear of neighbouring lines without an explicit lineHeight.
